sentences.en: A tight belt will interfere with circulation of the blood.
sentences.zh: 紧身腰带会影响血液循环。

sentences.en: You have no right to interfere in other people's affairs.
sentences.zh: 你没有权利干涉别人的事情。

sentences.en: The big nations should not interfere with the smaller nations.
sentences.zh: 大国不应干预小国事务。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：inter（在…之间）+fer（带来）+ e→来到中间→干涉，干扰
